name: Bastion brute
description: a huge armoured demon of the Cracked Road in heavy black plates riveted over cracked rock skin, a wall-like shield arm held forward, glowing orange cracks between the plates

poses.stand: standing square, shield arm held forward like a wall, orange cracks glowing between the plates, facing right
poses.struck: struck: plates ringing, sparks flying, rocked back a step
poses.dead: collapsed on its knees then flat, the armour loosening, orange glow dying

idle.action: breathes and shifts in place, glow pulsing slowly

attack.action: performs its signature attack toward the right, glow flaring

hurt.action: is struck, jerks back, then settles

die.action: flares bright, breaks apart in a burst of embers and goes still
